# Healthpoint

> Healthpoint is New Zealand's comprehensive healthcare provider directory and health services finder, helping patients locate GPs, hospitals, pharmacies, immunisation services, and urgent care with integrated health information and support resources.

Healthpoint serves as a central hub for finding and accessing healthcare services across New Zealand, offering both patient-facing search capabilities and provider management tools. The platform includes vaccination scheduling, emergency service locators, and multilingual support including Te Reo Māori resources.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare provider search
- General Practice (GPs)
- Public Hospital Services
- Immunisation and vaccination
- Pharmacy services
- Urgent and emergency care
- MMR vaccine
- Health services directory
- Patient preparation guides
- Mental health support helplines
- Te Reo Māori health resources
- Digital safety and privacy
- Service provider registration
- Vaccination locations
- New Zealand health system

## Core Healthcare Services

- [Healthpoint](https://healthpoint.co.nz): Homepage: Find NZ healthcare providers, referral info, services and treatment details
- [GPs / Accident & Urgent Medical Care](https://healthpoint.co.nz/gps-accident-urgent-medical-care): GP finder and urgent care provider directory for primary health services in NZ
- [Public Hospital Services](https://healthpoint.co.nz/public): Public hospital finder with medical specialties and emergency services information
- [Pharmacy](https://healthpoint.co.nz/pharmacy): Pharmacy services finder with prescription management and health treatment information

## Immunisation and Vaccination

- [Immunisation](https://healthpoint.co.nz/immunisation): Immunisation services, vaccination finder, NZ schedule and vaccine type information
- [Measles / Mumps / Rubella (MMR) vaccine](https://www.healthpoint.co.nz/immunisation/measles-mumps-rubella-mmr-vaccine): Information about MMR vaccine, measles, mumps, rubella and vaccination locations

## Patient Guides and Resources

- [Where to go for care](https://healthpoint.co.nz/useful-information/where-to-go-for-care): Guide to healthcare navigation and where to seek care in New Zealand
- [Preparing for your next health care visit](https://healthpoint.co.nz/useful-information/preparing-for-your-next-health-care-visit): Patient guide for preparing and planning healthcare visits with downloadable resources
- [Videos and training](https://healthpoint.co.nz/useful-information/videos-and-training): Video tutorials and training guides for Healthpoint and health services search
- [Ngā ratonga hauora hei toro māu?](https://healthpoint.co.nz/useful-information/nga-ratonga-hauora-hei-toro-mau): Te Reo Māori health services guide with helpline directory and support resources

## Provider Management and Registration

- [How to Edit and Update your Healthpoint page](https://healthpoint.co.nz/useful-information/how-to-edit-and-update-your-healthpoint-page): User guide for healthcare providers to edit and update their Healthpoint listings
- [List your service](https://healthpoint.co.nz/useful-information/list-your-service): Registration and listing process for new healthcare services in New Zealand

## Security and Safety

- [Digital Safety](https://healthpoint.co.nz/digital_safety): Guide to digital safety, browser privacy, and secure online health information access
